source.file: GTO Preflop Ranges - POKER TRAINER RANGES.csv

disputes.detail: The two charts are identical at 41.8%. Your older sizing rules in version 25.2 have the SB limping, which these charts don't include.
disputes.question: Should the SB open exactly the BTN range?
disputes.ruling: Keep it. The SB opens the BTN range, raise or fold, with no limping.
disputes.title: SB opening range

disputes.detail: AA calls in BTN v CO and BB v SB, and 5-bets in the other 13 vs 4-bet spots. These could be deliberate traps or typing errors.
disputes.question: Should AA call rather than 5-bet in these two spots?
disputes.ruling: Keep both. These are deliberate traps in spots where the hero acts last after the flop.
disputes.title: Aces facing a 4-bet

disputes.detail: No hand raises in any vs 5-bet spot, which implies a 5-bet is all-in at 100bb. If so, the 89 Raise cells facing a 4-bet should be labelled All-in. This has to be settled before drills start, because it changes spot ids.
disputes.question: Are the Raise cells in vs 4-bet spots all-ins?
disputes.ruling: Yes. Raise facing a 4-bet means all-in. Applied as rule R-004.
disputes.title: Are 5-bets all-in?

disputes.detail: The charts don't record sizes. Your older rules in version 25.2 use a 2.5bb open, 3x 3-bet and 2.5x 4-bet in position, and a 3.5bb open, 3.5x 3-bet and 2.75x 4-bet out of position.
disputes.question: What bet sizes do these charts assume?
disputes.ruling: Use the 25.2 rules. Opens go by seat. 3-bets and 4-bets judge position against the actual opponent.
disputes.title: Bet sizes

patches.evidence: Weakest of the three. This chart fits HJ, CO, BTN or SB, so CO rests on it following the real BB v HJ chart at line 646 in the sheet's usual order.
patches.reason: Four charts in the sheet are labelled vs 4bet BB v HJ, and BB v CO, BTN and SB have no chart of their own.

patches.evidence: Strongest of the three. BTN is the only villain whose 3-bet range contains every hand in this chart.
patches.reason: Four charts in the sheet are labelled vs 4bet BB v HJ, and BB v CO, BTN and SB have no chart of their own.

patches.evidence: This chart fits BTN or SB. Line 674 can only be BTN, which leaves SB, and that also matches the sheet's order.
patches.reason: Four charts in the sheet are labelled vs 4bet BB v HJ, and BB v CO, BTN and SB have no chart of their own.

rules.evidence: No hand raises in any vs 5-bet spot, only calls or folds. Ruling D-003.
rules.reason: The sheet writes every aggressive action as R, but a 5-bet is all-in at 100bb.
